summary: Closed for good: Google Maps and RV Life both mark Amish Country Campsite(s), 1930 US-62, 'Permanently closed', and an RV Life reviewer who drove by in September 2024 found the sign down and a private-drive sign up. No operator website ever existed; the Holmes County tourism directory stored in `website` no longer lists it. Nothing written.
flags: PERMANENT CLOSURE - drop candidate. Google Maps: 'Amish Country Campsite, 1930 US-62, Wilmot, OH 44689 ... Permanently closed' (4.6 over 165 reviews, the newest shown 3 years old; no phone or website on the listing). RV Life: 'Permanently Closed' banner; review 'It is a sad day' (date of stay Sep 2024): 'The campground is closed. ... I drove by and the sign is down and a Private drive sign is...'. The stored website (visitamishcountry.com RV parks & campgrounds page, a tourism directory) no longer lists it: it shows Evergreen Park RV Resort, Berlin RV Park, Coshocton KOA, Timbercrest, Baylor Beach Park and Scenic Hills RV Park. The only other web mentions are aggregators (campgroundviews 2012, campsitephotos 2021, The Dyrt).
